name: kazuhoshibuya.com
description: Personal site of Kazuho Shibuya, served from Cloudflare.

scripts.build: python3 scripts/build.py && node scripts/render-og.js && python3 scripts/build.py
scripts.lint: uvx ruff@0.17.0 check scripts tests && uvx ruff@0.17.0 format --check scripts tests && prettier --check .
scripts.format: uvx ruff@0.17.0 format scripts tests && prettier --write .
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run build && html-validate public/index.html && playwright test
